answer: Rule: each identity binds one hand-carved seal exposing three unclonable channels - ivory grain, marble fracture, copper tool marks. At registration the registry photographs it under fixed light, hashes all three, rejects any repeat of a live identity's channels, and binds the object to one key. A cast copies copper relief but not the marble fracture or the ivory grain, and a re-photo collides on the hash, so every puppet needs its own hand-cut object: fresh stock, fresh labour, no bulk discount. A farm of 1,000 puppets carves 1,000 seals; the honest agent carves once.
